# webbpulse_project (Data Source)

One project, looked up by name ignoring case, the default project included as `Default Project`. The API has no name lookup route, so this lists every project and filters in the provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "webbpulse_project" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

data "webbpulse_project" "default" {
  name = "Default Project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The project name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the project was created. Null for the default project.
- `description` (String) The project description.
- `id` (String) The project id, `prj-default` for the default project.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default project, which holds every workspace not moved elsewhere.
- `updated_at` (String) When the project was last changed. Null for the default project.
- `workspace_count` (Number) How many workspaces the project holds.
